items.text: Ifyou are designing a car forhigh acceleration,the equation F=ma tells you thatthe carshould havelowmass and theenginemustprovide ahigh accelerating force.Youmust also consider the force needed to stop the car.

items.label: text
items.text: When a moving object is stopped,it decelerates.

items.label: text
items.text: Anegative acceleration is a deceleration.

items.label: text
items.text: Ifa largedecelerationisneeded then theforcecausing thedecelerationmust belarge,too.Usuallya carisstopped byusing thebrakesin a controlledway so that the deceleration isnot excessive (too much).In an accident the car may collide with another vehicle or obstacle,causing a very rapid deceleration.
